Subject: OrthoNext discovery — alignment & next steps

Hi Danielle / Miguel — thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned before a pilot kickoff: 

Summary of pain points you shared
- Latency spikes on peak queries (affects triage flow) causing dropped sessions
- Cost unpredictability with current model routing + lack of caching
- Regulatory requirement: PHI redaction and on-prem inference for certain datasets

Goals for a successful pilot
- Demonstrate consistent request p95 latency < 250ms for the primary inference path
- Reduce per-inference token cost by >= 30% vs current baseline via batching + cache
- Verify redaction + key-rotation workflow meets OrthoNext security checklist

Proposed pilot / POC scope (MVP)
- Inference: redact+summarize triage notes using a 6B open model variant hosted in your VPC
- Data: 3 sample datasets (deidentified), 1 week of production-like traffic replay (10k requests/day)
- Eval: prompt set of 120 real-sample queries, automated quality checks (precision/recall for redaction + human ratings for summarization)

Success metrics (concrete)
- Latency: p95 < 250ms on baseline traffic profile
- Quality: automated redaction F1 >= 0.98; average human rating >= 4/5 on summaries
- Cost: unit token cost reduced >= 30% relative to current model

Owners / roles (tentative)
- Redwood technical lead: Ben Carter — integration & runtime tuning
- Redwood eval lead: Evelyn Hart — prompt set + human eval coordination
- OrthoNext product: Danielle Cruz — success criteria + access approvals
- OrthoNext infra: Miguel Santos — VPC/network & credentials

Immediate asks (please action where applicable)
1) OrthoNext: share a scoped sample dataset (deidentified) and one network contact for kickoff. Please send S3 location or secure transfer instructions.
2) OrthoNext: confirm compliance requirement for on-prem vs VPC — whether a subset of data must never leave their VPC.
3) Redwood: we’ll prepare an MVP scope doc and mutual action plan for signatures (attached: OrthoNext_MVP_scope.xlsx).
4) Schedule: propose kickoff week of Mar 9 — Jordan to propose exact slots once we have availability from OrthoNext.

Attachments: OrthoNext_MVP_scope.xlsx (MVP scope + timeline)
Related links: HubSpot deal RDW-2026-ON-3321: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

If anything above is off, flag it and I’ll adjust. Thanks again — excited to get this started.

Best,
